constraints.name: Scorer switches teams
constraints.rule: When the overload team scores, the scorer switches teams.

constraints.name: 3-zone choose your formation
constraints.rule: Create 3 pitch zones. Teams choose their formation; players may leave zones.
constraints.progression: Later remove zones and see whether shape remains.

constraints.name: Netball football
constraints.rule: Players pass/throw like netball and may throw into the goal.
constraints.progression: Use before normal football, then remove constraint.

constraints.name: Call / signal for the ball
constraints.rule: Reward useful calls or signals before receiving.
constraints.progression: Prefer reward to automatic free kick so shouting does not become artificial.

constraints.name: Silent football
constraints.rule: No talking during a short game.
constraints.progression: Ask how they found teammates without speech.

constraints.name: Own-half shot risk
constraints.rule: Shoot from inside own half and miss the goal: opposition gets a penalty/free shot.
constraints.progression: No goalkeeper for penalty; other team may try to put taker off.

constraints.name: Weaker-foot next goal
constraints.rule: Selected strong player must score their next goal with weaker foot.
constraints.progression: Use briefly so it remains a challenge rather than restriction.

constraints.name: Weaker-foot goal = double
constraints.rule: Goal with weaker foot counts double.
constraints.progression: Choice-based alternative to mandatory weaker foot.

constraints.name: Strong player cannot score next
constraints.rule: Selected strong player cannot score the team's next goal.
constraints.progression: Better if framed as helping others score.

constraints.name: Assist by strong player = double
constraints.rule: A goal assisted by selected strong player counts double.
constraints.progression: Usually preferable to simply banning them from scoring.

constraints.name: Everyone touches before goal
constraints.rule: Every player on the team must touch the ball before a goal counts.
constraints.progression: Can become forced in 5v5; use selectively.

constraints.name: Beat a player = bonus point
constraints.rule: Award a bonus point for a clear successful take-on.
constraints.progression: Simple but can over-reward unnecessary dribbles.

constraints.name: Dribble + score = double
constraints.rule: If a player beats an opponent and the team scores in the same attack, the goal counts double.
constraints.progression: Preferred dribbling reward: links take-on to useful outcome.

constraints.name: Dribble through gate before scoring
constraints.rule: Team must dribble through one of several gates before its goal can count.
constraints.progression: Multiple gates give choice; avoid one predictable bottleneck.

constraints.name: Attacking-third take-on bonus
constraints.rule: Successful take-on in attacking third earns a bonus point.
constraints.progression: Encourages purposeful dribbling in dangerous areas.
